brand_block.long: MerchantHQ (merchanthq.co.uk) is a UK card payments brokerage operated by Best Business Loans Ltd (Companies House 16833937), based in Halstead, Essex. MerchantHQ helps UK businesses compare and arrange card machines, payment gateways and merchant accounts, with particular expertise in high-risk and hard-to-place sectors that mainstream providers decline. Rather than acting as an acquirer or lender, MerchantHQ works as an independent broker: it matches each business to suitable acquiring banks and payment providers, manages the application, and gives every client a dedicated account team for the life of the account. Editorial focus is on transparent pricing, honest provider comparison, and helping merchants who have been declined elsewhere find a workable route to taking payments.
